body: New item from audit B-60 (proven): the Encore server links new music on an hourly tick (ENCORE_SCAN_EVERY_MIN=60); LibraryLinker.poke() has no caller; no CLI or API asks for a scan. 7,200 files: the music server scanned in 4 min 36 s, the link came 47 min later. Link when the scan finishes, wire poke, say it in words. A need of P0-13 (the walk).
